Chapter 1271: 24: Can'T Be Pulled In!

Chapter 1271: Chapter 24: Can’t Be Pulled In!

The Time Lord, at the peak of the Thirteenth Rank, has reached a stage where time beings begin to consolidate their timeline, striving to unify the past, present, and future.

In order to advance to a higher level.

In the first Origin World, among the six ancestors of the Ancient Country, even the strongest, Da Fu Ancestor, is far from reaching the Time Lord.

However, as Lin Yuan observes and comprehends the Rune Dao passed down by the Lord of Heaven Light, its description of the essence of runes far exceeds any Thirteenth Rank legacy Lin Yuan has ever seen.

This leads to the speculation that the Lord of Heaven Light might be a Time Lord.

“Perhaps it is just a powerful time being.”

Lin Yuan steadied himself; he is still at a much lower level, not even reaching the Thirteenth Rank, and cannot judge whether the Lord of Heaven Light is actually a Time Lord.

“These Rune Dao legacies are very helpful to me.”

Lin Yuan spent several days comprehending many of the legacies within the statue, especially related to the Rune Dao, and a smile appeared on his face.

Particularly the rune legacies from various Eternal Lords, which provided Lin Yuan with a clear view of the essence of the Rune Dao path. The Lord of Heaven Light’s ultimate pursuit of the Rune Dao is omnipotence.

Other Eternal Lords also have their pursuits regarding the Rune Dao, allowing Lin Yuan to vaguely sense the methods of each Eternal Lord.

“It’s still too little.”

Lin Yuan looked at the statue in front of him, feeling somewhat unsatisfied.

The legacies passed down by the Eternal Lords are so precious that even Li Hong at the pinnacle of the Second Realm only obtained a part, and as for more? There were none.

“Continue to explore other sect relics.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts gathered, believing that the direction he chose is correct.

In the short term, before fully developing the infinite Constant Sand World, he would not easily approach the center of the world or have any contact with the Demon God.

But the various legacies left by the Eternal Lords can be found within the many sect relics, even if not complete, they are enough for Lin Yuan.

“A Supreme Saint Sect level force should have more Eternal Lord legacies.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, those capable of establishing a Supreme Saint Sect are all at the Third Realm of Xiaoyao, such powerful beings generally have many ties with the Eternal Sect; attempting to cross into the Third Realm of Xiaoyao alone is too difficult.

With connections to the Eternal Sect, naturally, there are many legacies regarding the Eternal Lords left behind.

“Even for a Supreme Saint Sect level force, if targeted by a Source Demon, it would struggle to retreat fully.”

Lin Yuan silently thought, through Li Hong, he was well aware of the power of the Source Demon, equivalent to the Abyss Dragon.

Without going through a thousand years of cultivation, even Lin Yuan did not have full confidence to slay it.

…

First Origin World.

Capital of the Fierce Sun Kingdom, Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Meng Shi and several disciples taken in by Lin Yuan came to seek an audience as usual.

This was also the rule set by Lin Yuan; every so often, the disciples could ask about their confusions regarding cultivation in the Martial Tao.

“Master.” Meng Shi and the disciples were very respectful, looking at the young man sitting cross-legged. Runes intertwined and collided, vaguely sketching a vast world. However, the level of the runes was too high for Meng Shi and the others to discern the whole picture.

Even if they couldn’t understand or fully see, the disciples felt that each rune contained infinite mysteries, seeming like part of the essence of heaven and earth.

“The runes in front of Master, even a single one gives me a feeling that surpasses those Peak Venerables, what exactly are these runes?” Meng Shi and the disciples were shocked.

They could sense that each rune was casually condensed by Lin Yuan, thousands of runes continuously interweaving and colliding.

“It is said that Master is currently the unquestioned strongest among the six Ancient Countries, even the six ancestors look upon him with new eyes and give him great importance. Being able to become a disciple under Master is a tremendous fortune.” Meng Shi and the disciples thought to themselves.

As they spent more time under Lin Yuan, they became more aware of the weight carried by the title Galaxy Venerate, a status that even the ancestors would respectfully accommodate.

In the six Ancient Countries, the ancestors are the supreme beings. Since the founding of the Da Fu Ancient Country, no Heavenly Venerate has ever warranted such respect from the ancestors. Even the second and third ancestors in the Heavenly Venerate level failed to attract the attention of Da Fu Ancestor.

“At that time in the Thousand Fang Domain, I was worried I would implicate Master, fearing Master couldn’t withstand the Thousand Teeth King’s retaliation.”

Meng Shi thought, now it seems, what is the trivial Thousand Fang Domain to Master? Even the emperor of Da Ling Ancient Country must bow in respect before Master.

“State any doubts you have in your cultivation.”

Lin Yuan dispelled the runes in front of him and looked at his disciples.

These disciples were selected by Lin Yuan as the most suitable for martial cultivation, with the highest potential for the Martial Tao across the six Ancient Countries.

In the future, after Lin Yuan enters the Thirteenth Rank and establishes the Seventh Ancient Country, these disciples will handle many affairs, so he regularly guides them.

This is the representative face of martial cultivators for a long time to come, so Lin Yuan naturally needs to cultivate them well.

“Master, time is like flowing water, but how does it flow, and to where does it head?”

Meng Shi was the first to speak, being a being with Time Talent in martial arts, Lin Yuan thought highly of Meng Shi. Such talent is on par with those time-blooded miraculous beings in the Chaos Void.

Upon reaching the twelfth level of perfection, one can vaguely perceive many potential scenes of the future.

“Time…”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while, his thoughts moved slightly, and a rune gathered and emerged.

This rune is the ‘Time’ symbol from the Second Source World, infinitely complex, yet after complete condensation, it flows like a winding river of time.

The rune dao of the Second Source World replicates everything in existence, including the rules within its scope.

“This?”

Meng Shi stared at the rune before Lin Yuan, feeling as if this rune were alive; he truly witnessed the vast Dao of Time.

“Thank you, Master, for your guidance.”

Meng Shi watched with fascination for a while and solemnly bowed to Lin Yuan.

To hear the Dao in the morning and die in the evening is acceptable; moreover, he has now seen the Dao rather than merely hearing it. Lin Yuan effortlessly conjures the rune of ‘Time,’ which is the great Dao in his heart.

Other disciples were also observing that ‘Time’ rune, and even though they hadn’t embarked on the path of time, witnessing such an essence-revealing rune was immensely beneficial for them.

“Master, I…”

Quickly, the second and third disciples stepped forward.

Lin Yuan answered their queries one by one, and ultimately condensed the corresponding runes.

The rune inheritance of the Second Source World, its replication of the Dao of rules, is truly unbelievable, drastically lowering the threshold for cultivation. Especially the runes condensed by Lin Yuan eloquently expressed the essence of the rules.

…

Second Source World.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit swiftly passed towards a direction.

“I have already subdued thirty-six Great Demons, having sent all manifestations to the main body; regarding the sect’s influence ruins, one saint sect-level ruin has been discovered, though it pales compared to the ‘Li Hong’ Saint Sect, offering little aid to me.”

Lin Yuan thought while glancing further afield, “Now, let’s begin exploring even further.”

This Fang Yuan World is vast and boundless; according to Qingyun Saint Sect’s ‘map,’ Lin Yuan’s current position is analogous to the corner near the edge of this heaven and earth.

“Actually, the ‘demonic’ calamity of this Fang Yuan World benefits me more than it harms, at least it doesn’t draw the attention of the Eternal Lords.” Lin Yuan mused.

Absent the influence of ‘demonic’ calamities, it can be foreseen that with Lin Yuan’s continuous growth and gathering of rune inheritance, he would inevitably draw the eyes of eternal sects and even Eternal Lords.

The Eternal Lords, as beings of time, can observe many future timelines, but within this Fang Yuan World, considering the presence of beings like the Lord of Heaven Light, are unlikely to befriend Lin Yuan with full force like the ancestors of the Six Ancient Countries.

The ancestors of the Six Ancient Countries adopted such an approach because they envisioned the inevitability of Lin Yuan’s future timeline.

But the Lord of Heaven Light? If this time being truly is a Time Lord, observing enough timelines far enough, might see the timeline where Lin Yuan cannot cross into the Thirteenth Layer.

Thus, potentially intervening in the layout of his path.

Of course, this is merely a possibility.

Yet it’s Lin Yuan’s concern; until he crosses into the Thirteenth Layer, Lin Yuan is reluctant to interact with overly powerful time beings.

“Is that?”

Just then, Lin Yuan suddenly stopped, looking towards a valley below, lifting his brow slightly.

He faintly sensed rune fluctuations within the valley, “Another sect ruin?”

Lin Yuan felt a glimmer of joy. Ruins of sect influences are akin to free gift bags for him, and even the weakest sect is beneficial, though the aid might be limited.

“Let’s take a look.”

Lin Yuan did not enter the valley but approached to examine carefully.

However.

As Lin Yuan approached within a certain range of the valley.

Runes instantly covered the surroundings, and a golden figure with cold eyes condensed at the height of the valley.

“This?”

Lin Yuan appeared wary. The runes surrounding him gave a feeling that far exceeded the rune inheritance left by ‘Li Hong’; this valley’s sect ruin at least reached the Supreme Saint Sect level.

“Since you have arrived, you are a cultivator. The trial begins; this sect’s inheritance is unique, requiring trial completion before comprehending.” The golden figure with cold eyes at the valley height looked down upon Lin Yuan, speaking in a calm tone: “Enter.”

Having finished, the golden figure waved a hand, preparing to teleport Lin Yuan into the trial space.

Buzz—

An invisible ripple enveloped Lin Yuan, intending to draw him into a certain space.

“Hmm?”

The golden figure was slightly taken aback, realizing it couldn’t move Lin Yuan at all.
